title: md-heal reference: roles, token optimization, todo sync
desc: T3 reference for md-heal: the file role map (CLAUDE.md vs AGENTS.md vs README.md), token-optimization rule, and the todo-sync rule.
steps: ROLE MAP: project CLAUDE.md is Claude-facing project guidance; AGENTS.md is for Codex and other non-Claude agents; README.md is user-facing docs. Keep each in its lane and sync only overlapping subjects.

TOKEN OPTIMIZATION: if a workflow or command chain repeats across CLAUDE.md, README.md, or AGENTS.md, keep only a short pointer in the MD and move the executable detail into a skill. One canonical home per recurring flow avoids drift and repeated session load.

TODO SYNC: any pending task list stays in the repo CLAUDE.md Pending section. After completing a task mark it done and commit immediately. Never track todos only in conversation; CLAUDE.md is the canonical source.

requirements.expect: role map token optimization todo sync

author: claude
